description: This file contains unit tests for the USB mass storage functionality, including device mount/unmount events, device list retrieval, and partition info, using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks. It also includes mock implementations and test scenarios for handling USB device events via RPC and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: AsyncHandlerMock_UsbMassStorage
classes.description: Mock class for handling asynchronous USB mass storage events, with methods to simulate device mounted and unmounted events.

classes.name: USBMassStorageNotificationHandler
classes.description: Implements the IUSBMassStorage notification interface to handle device mount/unmount events, synchronize via condition variables, and store event data.

classes.name: USBMassStorageTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up and tearing down USB mass storage tests, including mock callbacks, service activation, and test scenarios.

methods.name: USBMassStorageTest::WaitForRequestStatus
methods.description: Waits for a specific event signal within a timeout period, returning the signalled event flags.

methods.name: USBMassStorageTest::Mock_SetDeviceDesc
methods.description: Mocks device descriptor retrieval and sets vendor/model info for specific USB devices.

methods.name: USBMassStorageTest::Mock_SetSerialNumberInUSBDevicePath
methods.description: Creates mock serial number files for USB devices and device paths.

methods.name: USBMassStorageTest::CreateUSBMassStorageInterfaceObjectUsingComRPCConnection
methods.description: Creates and initializes the USB mass storage interface object via RPC connection.
